title: Biobeat Digital Home Monitoring Feasibility
summary: To assess the feasibility of evaluating postoperative home monitoring with Biobeat digital monitoring. The investigators hypothesize that the Biobeat digital home monitoring platform will lead to a decrease in unplanned visits to the ED (Emergency Department). In addition, patients' quality of life is postulated to be improved compared to patients receiving the current standard of care without home monitoring.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient willing to provide informed consent
* Wi-fi or cellular connectivity at the patient's home
* Patient undergoing elective lung cancer surgery
* Patient familiar/comfortable with the use of technology such as online banking.

Exclusion Criteria:

\- Patients who are not comfortable with the use of technology.
